assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a panoramic transparent painted background plate for a quiet personal-website footer animation. Reference: attached flower image is ONLY a reference for the painterly 3D-to-2D art direction: sculpted angular gouache color planes, subtle brush texture, soft natural light, muted colors, tactile hand-painted volumes. Create a NEW coastal scene, no flowers. Very wide panoramic composition approximately 3:1. Slightly elevated fixed view over a small peaceful harbor and a large open bay. LEFT quarter: a modest pale stone quay and pier with a few low cream harbor buildings, subdued terracotta roofs, a small lighthouse, olive-sage coastal planting and rocks. Pier reaches toward the middle-left water, with an unobstructed departure lane to its right. Remaining middle and RIGHT are mostly calm muted blue-green seawater receding toward a pale misty distant horizon; a very low small rocky headland at the far right edge. Sea occupies the lower half, distant water softly fades into transparent upper sky. Water should have sparse broad painterly facets, ivory reflections, gentle horizontal ripples, lots of uncluttered room for a tiny boat to animate from lower-left harbor toward upper-right distant water. Fine irregular painted perimeter blends naturally into a white webpage, not a rectangular illustration card. Warm ivory stone, sage green, dusty teal-blue water, restrained sandy ochre. Genuine transparent alpha outside the painted vignette, especially upper sky and margin; no checkerboard, no white matte. No boats, no birds, no people, no labels, no text, no border, no photorealism, no flat vector clipart. Preserve the whole harbor silhouette, no cropping of buildings. Scene should be an elegant small world with airy negative space, not a busy city or giant dramatic landscape.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent sailboat sprite for a fixed-view website harbor animation. Attached images are STYLE references only: match the quiet gouache harbor and sculpted brush planes of the flower. Create a small classic single-mast coastal sailboat with an ivory triangular mainsail, a smaller ivory forward jib, a warm honey-brown wooden hull with a narrow muted dusty-blue stripe, simple tiny cabin. Bow points RIGHT, viewed from slightly above and behind its port side, a gentle three-quarter angle heading right and slightly away toward distant water. Crisp recognizable silhouette at 60–100px wide. Painterly 3D-to-2D, warm cream lit faces, blue-gray shaded faces, restrained visible brushwork. Whole boat centered with all sail tips, rigging and hull visible, at least 12% transparent margins. No water, no wake, no background, no ground shadow, no birds, no people, no text or markings. The bottom hull edge is the waterline, not a visible keel. Genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard, no white matte. One boat only, one pose, square image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent animation sprite sheet for one small seagull, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, eight separate poses. Attached harbor is STYLE reference only. Painterly gouache 3D-to-2D rendering, restrained angular brush planes, warm ivory white feathers, subtle slate blue-gray shadow planes, dark gray wing tips, tiny muted ochre beak. Bird facing RIGHT in a three-quarter side view slightly from below, body horizontal, small round head, short tail, long elegantly tapered wings. Same individual bird, identical body size and body center at exact center of every cell, SAME head direction and camera in all frames. Row-major continuous eight-frame wingbeat: 1 wings high up, 2 halfway down, 3 wings horizontal, 4 halfway down below body, 5 wings lowest down, 6 halfway rising below body, 7 wings horizontal, 8 halfway rising above body. Both wings visibly attached to the shoulder in every pose, no detached feathers. Full wing tips and beak remain at least 15% inside every cell boundary; do NOT let adjacent birds overlap. Genuine transparent background including between cells. No labels, no cell dividers, no numbers, no scenery, no water, no shadows underneath, no photorealism, no flat vector icons. Wide 2:1 overall image, regular four-by-two layout. The sheet must read as sequential poses, not a flock in space.
